errors.text: The proposed intervention is hot deformation plus aging rather than the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment in a hexahedron-anvil apparatus.
The proposed pressure of roughly 0.5 GPa is more than an order of magnitude below the required 6 GPa and therefore cannot test the hypothesized extreme-pressure effect.
The HIP comparison does not isolate extreme pressure because the treatment arm differs simultaneously in deformation history, temperature, time, and pressure.
The baseline is taken from ductile AlCoCrFeNi2.1 rather than the brittle homogenized Al0.7CoCrFeNi state, creating a composition and initial-property mismatch.
